record.context_brief: Fourth moment of quadratic Dirichlet L-functions
record.original_question: Let chi_{8d} denote the quadratic character attached to the fundamental discriminant 8d, with d ranging over odd squarefree integers 0 < d < X. Determine a polynomial P of degree 10 such that sum L(1/2, chi_{8d})^4 = X P(log X) + o(X), decide whether the error term can be improved to a power saving, and determine whether the Multiple Dirichlet Series method can recover at least the initial coefficients of P.

evidence.quote: Determine a polynomial P of degree 10 such that sum_{0<d<X} L(1/2, χ8d)^4 = X P(log X) + o(X) where d ranges through odd square-free numbers and χ8d denotes the quadratic character associated to the fundamental discriminant 8d. Can the error term o(X) be replaced by a power savings error term? Can the Multiple Dirichlet series method be used to obtain the first coefficients of P?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
For each odd squarefree positive integer $d$, let $\chi_{8d}$ denote the real primitive quadratic Dirichlet character of conductor $8d$ (the Kronecker symbol attached to the fundamental discriminant $8d$), and let $L(s,\chi_{8d})$ be its associated Dirichlet $L$-function. Consider the fourth moment
$$ S(X) \;=\; \sum_{\substack{0<d<X\\ d\text{ odd, squarefree}}} L\!\left(\tfrac{1}{2},\chi_{8d}\right)^{4}. $$

(a) Exhibit an explicit polynomial $P(t)\in\mathbb{R}[t]$ of degree $10$ such that
$$ S(X) \;=\; X\,P(\log X) \;+\; o(X) \qquad (X\to\infty), $$
and determine all of its coefficients.

(b) Determine whether the error term $o(X)$ in this asymptotic formula can be replaced by a power-saving error term of the form $O(X^{1-\delta})$ for some fixed $\delta>0$.

(c) Determine whether the Multiple Dirichlet Series method (i.e. the analytic continuation of the multiple Dirichlet series $\sum_d L(s,\chi_{8d})^{4}\, d^{-w}$ and the study of its polar structure) can be used to recover at least the leading coefficients of $P$.
artifact.status_search_result: Heath-Brown, Soundararajan, and Soundararajan–Young established asymptotic formulas with the leading main terms for the fourth moment of quadratic Dirichlet L-functions; recent work has extended this to four leading main terms (e.g. arXiv:2402.01497, "The fourth moment of quadratic Dirichlet L-Functions II"). However, the complete determination of the conjectural degree-10 polynomial P, a power-saving error term in this family, and a derivation of the leading coefficients of P via the Multiple Dirichlet Series method remain open as of recent literature.

status_evidence.title: The fourth moment of quadratic Dirichlet L-Functions II
status_evidence.snippet: Asymptotic formula with four main terms for the fourth moment of quadratic Dirichlet L-functions, building on work of Soundararajan and Soundararajan–Young.
status_evidence.claim: Only the leading several terms of the conjectural degree-10 polynomial have been established; full asymptotic with power saving in this family is not known.

status_evidence.title: The fourth moment of quadratic Dirichlet L-functions over function fields
status_evidence.snippet: The fourth moment is expected to behave like q^(2g+1) P(2g+1) with P a polynomial of degree 10, following conjectures of Andrade–Keating.
status_evidence.claim: The expected polynomial in the asymptotic is of degree 10 (function-field analog), supporting the conjectured shape over number fields.

status_evidence.title: The fourth moment of quadratic Dirichlet L-functions
status_evidence.snippet: Establishes asymptotic for the fourth moment of quadratic Dirichlet L-functions following Soundararajan and Soundararajan–Young methods.
status_evidence.claim: Establishes main-term asymptotics but does not give a power-saving error term or all ten coefficients.
